biggest_catch: The $300 is paid in $50 monthly increments over six months — and a single missed $1,000+ direct deposit month forfeits the remaining bonus.
catches: Offer available 6/1/2026 to 12/31/2026. Promo code NM26 required at account opening.
Must open a KeyPoint Checking account with a $10 minimum opening deposit.

Member must establish a recurring qualified monthly direct deposit of at least $1,000 from salary or personal income (e.g., pension, Social Security, or government benefits) for 6 consecutive months to the Checking account; first qualifying direct deposit must post within 60 days after account opening.

Recurring transfers or deposits from other accounts held at KeyPoint or other institutions, debit/credit card payments, account-to-account transfers, or peer-to-peer services (e.g., Zelle or Venmo) do NOT qualify.

The $300 direct deposit bonus is credited to the Checking account in $50 monthly increments for each consecutive month in which the required direct deposit is received, up to 6 months; total bonus credited within 9 months of new account opening.
Interruptions or failure to meet the direct deposit requirements forfeit the remaining bonus payments; KeyPoint may verify deposit sources and withhold bonuses.
Student and Kids Checking accounts are not eligible.
New Members only: anyone who had any KeyPoint account within two years of the new account open date is ineligible.
Cannot be combined with other promotions; KeyPoint employees, officials, and their immediate families may not participate.
Taxes on bonuses, if any, are the recipient's responsibility; KeyPoint complies with federal and state tax reporting laws.
